name: Spoks
description: Connect Spoks with Claude to write on-brand campaigns using your real products and discount codes, build automations like abandoned cart and win-back flows, create segments from live customer data, and report on the revenue and clicks your sends actually drove. Everything Claude creates lands as a draft in Spoks — you review, then you send.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Spoks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Spoks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.spoks.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Spoks MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spoks lists 28 MCP tools, including add_flow_step, create_flow, create_segment, discounts_search, draft_campaign, get_campaign, get_campaign_statistics, get_contact, get_flow, get_flow_blueprints, get_flows, and get_links.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Spoks?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Spoks in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Spoks requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Spoks is developed by Spoks. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
